svg.text: Matrix Factorization of Cascaded Diagnosis: Rank-Deficient End-to-End Aliasing vs. Unimodular Prefix Basis Π
A. Rank-Deficient End-to-End Matrix O_e2e = [1₁₆ᵀ ⊗ Ω_hop | e₀]
m=1 (/dev/tty key block), m=3 (TCP SYN drop), m=5 (sshd UseDNS UDP/53)
• Bayesian update Λ_e2e(o) preserves prior ratios across all aliased states!
B. Unimodular Prefix Probe Matrix Π & First-Difference Inverse Π⁻¹
Exact Frontier Recovery: u_{k*} = Π⁻¹ y (where y = Π u_{k*} is monotone step vector)
Why Prefix Bisection Achieves Shannon Optimality:
• Because y = Π u_{k*} = (0,...,0, 1,...,1)ᵀ is a monotone step function,
we never need to evaluate all D=128 rows of Π (O(D) linear scan).
• Binary bisection evaluates only log₂(D+1) ≈ 7.0155 rows of Π to locate
the unique non-zero first difference (Π⁻¹ y)_{k*} = y_{k*} - y_{k*-1} = 1!
• Requires uniform -F <cfg> to prevent P_SSH from stripping BatchMode=yes!
